title: Mixed pair A-B at rest, separation 2.5: does cross-species coupling follow the A-A law?
pitch: First cross-species coupling test. One A and one B at rest, horizontal, centred, separation 2.5, tracker, T = 0.6. Pre-registered: if the A-B coupling equals the A-A law (P-0034 table applied to both particles), a single scale s on that table fits with s = 1. Falsifier: fitted s outside 1 +/- 0.05, or judged RMSE/L above 0.021 against the A-A prediction. A pass licenses a mixed-pair table; a fail means mixed pairs need their own K(r).
